47.63947,4.38982: ASM International has designated Forge of Fontenay An historical landmark "The Forge of Fontenay, erected around 1220 as a part of the Abbey of Fontenay, is the first metallurgical factory in Europe and the palce of the invention of the hydraulic hammer. This invention became the basis of Industrial manufacturing of iron in Europe."
47.63948,4.38844: UNESCO Convention du Patriomoine Mondial L'Abbaye Cistercienne de Fontenay figure sur la liste du Patrimoine Mondial Cultural et Naturel L inscription sur cette liste sous la recommandation de l'ICOMOS consacre la valeur unierselle et exceptionelle de ce bien afin de contribuer a sa sauvegarde au benefice de l'humanite
